steps: Parked Spear+Dagger from StarterPack into ServerStorage
generate_mesh a single-edged curved falchion; scaled to ~3.6-stud sword; captured silhouette (round pommel, wrapped grip, straight crossguard, curved blade)
make_tool with the mesh as Handle

recipe.text: Falchion: a Cube-generated single-edged curved cleaver blade (distinct from prior straight swords/daggers/spears), persisted via save_mesh so the Handle survives Play. make_tool used the single mesh as the Handle at the hilt. Fast-swing behavior (0.10/0.12/0.30) with a short-reach (5) moderate-damage (22) server-authoritative hitbox. No animation bound (out of scope for this rung).
